title: Giant Soccer Ball 60 cm – Inflatable for Garden & Pool
descriptionHtml:
Half the party sits still and watches

Garden games are the same every summer, and the youngest never get to the ball. What was supposed to be play ends with three people playing and the rest waiting.

A soccer ball nobody can miss

A 60-centimeter ball changes the whole game: everyone hits it, nobody is bad and every shot looks dramatic. Light enough for the five-year-old, big enough to make the adults run. Inflate it for the pool, the beach or the lawn – and let the air out when the party is over.

Features

  • Everyone can join in right away – a 60 cm ball can't be missed
  • Soft to receive – light, air-filled PVC instead of a hard ball
  • Works everywhere – pool, beach, lawn and gym hall
  • Small when the party is over – let the air out and put it in the shed

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
